posts.text: I think we’re used to getting everything we want. But that’s not how the real world works. The Iranians have closed the Strait of Hormuz and can now use the world economy as leverage. I don’t think we understand the position we’re in. Israel has put us in an untenable place.

The old dividing line was Left vs. Right. And I’m sure we’ll get back to that at some point. But right now, the new dividing lines are Patriots vs. Israelis. Grassroots vs Establishment. American forces have assembled online and can’t wait to defeat the establishment and MSM.

It's weird how little national media is talking about this. Do they think it's a national security issue to discuss this? Do they think Iran is unaware of this calculus. They say they're perfectly aware of it. In fact, they're trying to get us to waste our defensive missiles.

Here's a critical part of the war no one is talking about - we're running low on interceptor missiles. Once we run out, we have to leave. Otherwise our ships are sitting ducks. So, we might not have a choice on whether to end the war. Staying past that can only make things worse.

I don’t think Trump is any different than he’s ever been. He’s always been nuts. When you’re winning, it looks like brash confidence with a dangerous swagger. When you’re losing, it looks like a deranged, sweaty tooth madman. That’s the stage we’re in now.

Of course, @RoKhanna answers first. We appreciate that you care enough about the voters to respond and let us know it wasn't you! See, how simple that was. I hope more candidates take the opportunity to get easy credit for this. Being against dark money and AIPAC is not hard.


Ro Khanna (@RoKhanna)

Thanks for asking. No I did not. I hope others answer directly.



— https://nitter.net/RoKhanna/status/2042772702084341893#m
